messages:
ash: quick follow-up from the PM: yesterday's kv OOM
vikram: i saw the pattern too. tenant spike + long residency. happy to lead a focused profiling pass. I'll run jemalloc tcache snapshots + malloc_prof sampling. target: artifacts by Mon morning.
sylvia: i'll take operational controls. propose two short-term mitigations: 1) per-shard soft eviction threshold at 85% mem, 2) enable opportunistic slab compact every 10m. canary plan: 3 nodes, 10% traffic for 24h.
ash: can you add the exact rollout script to the ticket? we'll coordinate a maintenance window if needed.
vikram: putting notes in RINF-1267. quick snippet of what i plan to capture:
```
jeprof --dot /tmp/jeheap
sudo pmap -x pid > /tmp/pmap
capture heap profile every 5m for 2h
```
ops-bot: Alert suppressed for test canary window 2026-03-28T02:00Z -> 2026-03-29T02:00Z per request from #eng-runtime
sylvia: rollout rollback criteria: 1) >10% increase in p50 GC pause, 2) new OOM within 12h, 3) more than 3 tenants hitting soft limit. If any trigger, immediate rollback and page oncall.
oncall-sre: ack, i'll watch the channel and add a short playbook entry to the ticket for the oncall run (include how to dump alloc traces + how to scale-down writer pods). Also set a temporary paging threshold on kv.rss_bytes.
vikram: adding regression detection: diff of top-10 alloc sites vs baseline. If top site increases >2x, create an automatic infra alert to the team.
ash: summary: Vikram=profiling (artifacts Mon), Sylvia=canary & ops mitigations (deploy Tue AM), Ash=tracking + customer comms. Sync Wed 10am to decide full rollout. Any objections? :eyes:
vikram: none from me.
sylvia: none. i'll flag if canary shows noisy tenant issues.
oncall-sre: i'll prepare runbook.
